subject: Chemistry
title: Classification of Elements and Periodicity
summary: Mendeleev ne elements ko atomic mass se lagaya aur na mile elements ke liye gaps chhode. Moseley ne dikhaya ki atomic number zyada basic hai — modern periodic law: properties atomic number ke periodic functions hain.
Long form periodic table mein 18 groups aur 7 periods hain, aur last electron jis subshell mein jaata hai uske hisaab se s-, p-, d-, f-blocks.
Periodic trends effective nuclear charge aur shielding se aate hain: period mein aage atoms chhote aur electrons zyada kas kar pakadte hain; group mein neeche bade aur dheela pakadte hain.
Key trends: atomic/ionic radius, ionisation enthalpy, electron gain enthalpy, electronegativity aur valence. Exceptions (N vs O, Be vs B, F vs Cl) exam ke favourite hain.

formulas.name: Modern periodic law
formulas.formula: properties of elements are periodic functions of their atomic numbers

formulas.name: Position from configuration
formulas.formula: period = highest n;  s-block group = valence e⁻;  p-block group = 10 + valence e⁻ (ns + np);  d-block group = ns + (n − 1)d electrons
formulas.when: Z se period, group aur block nikaalna.

formulas.name: Effective nuclear charge
formulas.when: Saare size aur energy trends samjhaana.

formulas.name: Atomic radius trend
formulas.formula: decreases across a period, increases down a group;  noble gases quoted as van der Waals radii
formulas.mistake: Noble gas ka van der Waals radius doosre elements ke covalent radius se compare mat karo.

formulas.name: Ionic radius
formulas.formula: cation < parent atom < anion;  isoelectronic species: higher Z → smaller
formulas.when: N³⁻ > O²⁻ > F⁻ > Na⁺ > Mg²⁺ > Al³⁺.

formulas.name: Ionisation enthalpy
formulas.formula: IE₁ < IE₂ < IE₃ …;  increases across a period, decreases down a group
formulas.mistake: Exceptions: B < Be aur O < N (stable 2s² aur half-filled 2p³) — bhoolo mat. Period 3 mein bhi: Mg > Al (3s² stable, Al ka 3p¹ asaani se nikalta) aur P > S (3p³ half-filled), isliye Na < Al < Mg < Si < S < P.

formulas.name: Electron gain enthalpy
formulas.formula: more negative across a period, less negative down a group;  Cl has the most negative value
formulas.mistake: F, Cl se kam negative hai — chhoti 2p shell aane wale electron ko repel karti hai, ulta mat samjho.

formulas.name: Electronegativity (Pauling)
formulas.formula: increases across, decreases down;  F 4.0 > O 3.5 > N 3.0 = Cl 3.0 (N and Cl are the SAME on the Pauling scale)

formulas.name: Metallic and non-metallic character
formulas.formula: metallic character decreases across, increases down
formulas.when: Oxides ki nature: period mein basic → amphoteric → acidic.

formulas.name: Valence
formulas.formula: s/p-block: valence = group electrons or 8 − group electrons
formulas.when: Compounds ke formula likhna (jaise Al₂O₃) aur common oxidation states.

examples.title: Z = 33 ki position
examples.problem: Z = 33 wala element: period aur block?

examples.title: Shielding estimate
examples.problem: Simple shielding (andar ki 1s² = 1.0 each, 2s²2p⁶ = 0.85 each) se Na ke 3s electron ka Z_eff?
examples.solution: Z_eff = 11 − (2 × 1.0 + 8 × 0.85) = 2.2 — bahar ka electron dheela pakda hai, Na use aasaani se kho deta hai.

examples.title: Ionic radii ka order
examples.problem: Na⁺, F⁻, Mg²⁺, O²⁻ size ke order mein.
examples.solution: Sab mein 10 electrons; zyada protons zyada kheenchte hain: O²⁻ > F⁻ > Na⁺ > Mg²⁺.

examples.title: Ionisation enthalpy ka order
examples.problem: B, C, N, O first ionisation enthalpy ke order mein.
examples.solution: B < C < O < N. N (2p³, half-filled) extra stable; O paired 2p electron aasaani se khota hai.

examples.title: Sabse negative electron gain enthalpy
examples.problem: F, Cl, Br, O mein sabse negative electron gain enthalpy kiski?
examples.solution: Cl. F chhota hai, isliye uski compact 2p shell mein electron–electron repulsion uski value ko Cl se kam negative bana deta hai.

topics.title: History of classification
topics.explain: Döbereiner ke triads (Li, Na, K), Newlands ka law of octaves, Lothar Meyer ke volume curves, aur Mendeleev ka periodic table (1869) jisne eka-aluminium (Ga) aur eka-silicon (Ge) predict kiye. Moseley (1913) ne dikhaya ki atomic number se order sahi aata hai.

topics.title: Blocks of the table
topics.explain: s-block (groups 1, 2): reactive metals, kam IE. p-block (13–18): metals, metalloids aur non-metals, halogens aur noble gases bhi. d-block (3–12): transition metals, variable valency, rangeen ions. f-block: lanthanoids aur actinoids neeche.

topics.title: Nomenclature of new elements
topics.explain: Z > 100 wale elements ko digits ke roots se temporary IUPAC naam: 0 nil, 1 un, 2 bi, 3 tri, 4 quad, 5 pent, 6 hex, 7 sept, 8 oct, 9 enn + 'ium'. Z = 120 unbinilium (Ubn).

topics.title: Why trends happen
topics.explain: Period mein electrons same shell mein aate hain aur nuclear charge badhta hai, isliye Z_eff badhta hai: chhota radius, zyada IE, zyada negative electron gain enthalpy, zyada electronegativity. Group mein neeche nayi shell aur zyada shielding, isliye trends ulte.

topics.title: Anomalous behaviour of the first element
topics.explain: Har group ka pehla element (Li, Be, B, C, N, O, F) baaki se alag: chhota size, zyada electronegativity, d orbitals nahi (maximum covalency 4). Diagonal relationship: Li–Mg, Be–Al, B–Si milti-julti properties.

topics.title: Chemical reactivity and oxides
topics.explain: Reactivity period ke dono siron par sabse zyada (alkali metals, halogens). Period 3 mein oxides strongly basic (Na₂O) se amphoteric (Al₂O₃) hote hue strongly acidic (Cl₂O₇) tak badalte hain.

ratta: Modern law: periodic in atomic number (Moseley).
Period = highest n;  p-block group = 10 + ns + np electrons.
Radius ↓ across, ↑ down;  isoelectronic: more Z → smaller.
Most negative electron gain enthalpy: Cl (not F).
Oxides across period 3: basic → amphoteric → acidic.
IE period 3: Na 496 < Al 577 < Mg 737 < Si 786 kJ/mol (Mg > Al, P > S).
Ga ka m.p. sirf 303 K (haath mein pighal jaata) — Cs (~302 K) jaisa bahut kam, high nahi.
